Dim ws As Worksheet, r As Range, s As String, i As Long, v As Variant
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
Dim c As New Collection
c.Add 1, "one": c.Add 2, "two": c.Add 3, Before:=1
s = c.Count & "|" & c(1) & "|" & c("two")

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
ws.Delete
Application.DisplayAlerts = True
Probe = s
End Function

Do Until i >= 3: i = i + 1: Loop

s = s & "|" & i

ws.Delete
Application.DisplayAlerts = True
Probe = s
End Function
